caption:
Your ads are working. Your front desk might not be.

Most owners track cost per lead and never hear the calls those leads generate.

Run this 10-minute audit this week:

1. Turn on call recording (most phone systems and CRMs include it free)
2. Pull 3 calls from new leads
3. Listen to the first 15 seconds of each
4. Check three things: name and callback number captured, business name stated, a time booked instead of 'I'll follow up'

Find the line that fails most. Retrain on that one line, not the whole script.

Check your state's call recording consent law before you turn this on.
